title: REQ · game tsconfig resolves the @game alias
summary: tsc and vitest resolve @game to game/src consistently.
description: Context: vitest.config.ts maps @game to ./src but game/tsconfig.json has no paths, so tests importing @game fail typecheck. Desired behavior: tsconfig maps @game/* to src/*. Expected result: npm run typecheck resolves @game imports. Why: tests must import through the alias.
acceptance_criteria: Given game/tsconfig.json, when parsed, then compilerOptions.paths['@game/*'] equals ['./src/*']
Given a test importing '@game/engine/layers', when tsc runs, then no module-not-found error is reported

preserve: strict, include and other compiler options
